thread:
jen (Marketing): quick thread  PartnerStack reached out about a joint marketplace launch + webinar. They want a launch post, marketplace description, 30m demo + 15m Q&A, and a short benchmark callout. timeline ~3 weeks. who can own content, routing, and assets?

omar (Partnerships): we can co-host. PartnerStack prefers June 8 or 10. We'll provide logos, one benchmark slide (PNG) and speaker bios. legal wants 48h for any quotes.

lucy (Growth): Routing: create SFDC campaign "PS_Marketplace_Jun". utm_source=partnerstack, utm_medium=webinar, utm_campaign=ps_launch_jun. Gate recording for lead capture. I'll add hidden field "ps_ref" for attribution and set up webhook to our lead lambda.

kevin (Content): Deliverables: short marketplace blurb (3 bullets), 700-900 word launch blog that can be reused as listing, registration landing copy, and 2 email templates (announce + reminder). I can draft blurb + landing by Tue. Need benchmark numbers and 2 screenshots.

jen (Marketing): owners: kevin -> content, lucy -> routing/tracking, omar -> partner assets & legal. I'll handle promo calendar + host.

omar (Partnerships): we'll drop assets Mon AM. can try to secure a joint customer quote but need time.

lucy (Growth): Registration form fields: first name, last name, email, company, role, monthly token bracket, consent. Hidden field "ps_ref" for mapping. Also recommend Segment event "partner_webinar_signup".

kevin (Content): For benchmark callout, eng please confirm a 1-line stat we can use like "reduces per-token inference cost by up to 35%". if eng can't sign off, we'll hedge with "up to ~35%".

jen (Marketing): @eng-platform please confirm wording by Fri. avoid exact numbers without sign-off.

event-bot: Event created: "PartnerStack x Redwood  Launch Webinar" Jun 10 10:00 PT. Invites: jen, omar, lucy, kevin.

omar (Partnerships): partner prefers Jun 10 to match their newsletter. ok with recording gated.

lucy (Growth): I'll set up SFDC campaign + webhook today. Need auth details from eng for webhook.

kevin (Content): small ask  can we capture a 45s demo clip during rehearsal for social? also need 3-4 pull quotes for the blog.

jen (Marketing): schedule 20m dry run one week before. production will capture clips. promo cadence: 3 weeks out teaser, registration open 2 weeks out, reminders 1wk and 2d. banners ready 10 days prior.

omar (Partnerships): legal will review quotes in 48h. I'll confirm customer quote permission by Wed.

lucy (Growth): next steps: kevin drafts copy (due Tue), lucy completes routing (due Mon), omar provides assets (due Mon), jen finalizes promo calendar (due Thu).

kevin (Content): noted. creating Notion page and assigning reviewers. will ping when draft up.

jen (Marketing): locking Jun 10 unless any objections. :rocket:

omar (Partnerships): good to go from partner side. excited! :handshake:

lucy (Growth): routing ready on my end.
